De Burlo Group Has Increased Its Holding in Apple (AAPL) by $1.09 Million; As Celgene (CELG) Share Price Declined, Holder Associated Banc-Corp Lifted Stake
May 17, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
De Burlo Group Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 4.82% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. De Burlo Group Inc bought 6,447 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 140,138 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $23.72M, up from 133,691 at the end of the previous reported quarter. De Burlo Group Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $924.93B market cap company. The stock increased 0.93% or $1.74 during the last trading session, reaching $188.18. About 17.26 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Associated Banc-Corp increased its stake in Celgene Corp (CELG) by 3.25% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Associated Banc-Corp bought 6,573 shares as the company’s stock declined 19.30% with the market. The institutional investor held 208,989 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $21.81 million, up from 202,416 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Associated Banc-Corp who had been investing in Celgene Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $59.09 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.76% or $0.62 during the last trading session, reaching $81.36. About 6.04 million shares traded. Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) has declined 31.28% since May 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.83% the S&P500.
Associated Banc-Corp, which manages about $1.85B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE:MA) by 3,066 shares to 75,191 shares, valued at $11.38M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Associated Banc Corp (NYSE:ASB) by 66,169 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 2.63 million shares, and cut its stake in Chevron Corp New (NYSE:CVX).
